pages.text: The boots have their abilities focus on mobility: Shadow Walker makes the wearer capable of crouching midair in dark areas. This includes the Darkness created with a $(l:equipment/light_devourer)$(0)$(n)Light Devourer$(), everywhere without light under the night sky, or simple unlit caves. The Great Stool lets the user raise themself up with a Stool that comes forth from their soles.
